```text
# #3800: CI: daily super run failed
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

[super run 43277060354](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43277060354) on `_staging` (`3d347d9`, workflow_dispatch) failed:

| Job | Result |
|---|---|
| [fuzz (4/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43277060354/job/131395849666) | failure |
| [fuzz (3/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43277060354/job/131395850228) | failure |

Each link opens that job's log. This issue stays open while the run is red and the next run that passes every job closes it. `gh workflow run super.yml --ref <branch>` runs it again on demand.

Night bot: this run is on `_staging`, so it is yours, and it comes first (`priority:high`, and you take it before every other queued item): production promotes itself only from a daily run on `_staging` that passes every job, so it waits on this fix, and `_staging` holds still until this issue closes (scripts/promote-staging.sh, the freeze). Fix every failed job here, in the one pull request on `main` that closes this: when it closes, `_staging` takes main's first green commit after the close and the super run starts on it at once, and a run still red opens a new issue. Before you start, look for an open pull request or issue already fixing one of these jobs, and build on it instead of fixing the same test twice. Root-cause each failed job from its log and fix it in a pull request: a flake is not a root cause, so make a flaky test robust instead of re-running it, and never skip, disable or quarantine a test to get green. Reproduce it with the job's own command (CLAUDE.md, Commands; one fuzz seed is `cargo jackioh fuzz --from <seed> --seeds 1`, with `--handicap` for the handicapped wave and `--duos` for the Duos wave; a daily test is `cargo test -p <crate> <name> -- --ignored`). A pull request's CI runs only the e2e smoke specs and leaves the tests marked `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` out, so say in the pull request which job here the fix makes pass and how you checked it. You cannot change `.github/`: make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, and when the rest needs a workflow or an action, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them.

---
_Posted by `.github/workflows/super.yml`._
```

## Found (local runs of the shards' exact commands on a 3d347d9 release build, /tmp/fz/*.log)
- super.yml fuzz shard k: plain + handicap seeds (k-1)*2500+1..k*2500, Duos (k-1)*500+1..k*500.
- s4 plain PASS, s4 handicap PASS, s4 Duos FAIL seed 1628; s3 plain FAIL seeds 6091, 6140; s3 handicap PASS;
  s3 Duos (1001-1500) running.
- All three are the new I16 check (#3746, 31a2dde526), each a distinct engine leak:
  A. Duos 1628: C+ #31 Fusion Lab fused Rod of Ages (stinkyscape-016, Field Spell, endOfTurn grant_random_keywords
     self) into Two Grapes (classicplus-065, Spell) -> fused Spell. resolve.rs flag_return_to_hand_at_end_of_turn flags
     any Spell with end_of_turn (R155 says only one "whose resolving face declares an end-of-turn return");
     triggers.rs zone_registers_hook_in runs flagged graveyard endOfTurn (R153) -> Rod's text grants Poisonous to the
     graveyard card.
  B. 6091: fused Unit [core-093 Combo-Index, classic-087, classic-044 Back from the GY, classic-031, core-093,
     classic-081, stinkyscape-114]; Cry part 2 exiles self ("Exile this"), part 4 Combo-Index start_grade ->
     combo_index.rs write_grade writes counters.grade on the exiled card.
  C. 6140 (glitch-boards): fused Field Trap played from graveyard; earlier part discards chosen hand card c47
     (classic-063), later KY's Constant (classicplus-041) part set_number cost=3 -> tune.rs write_number Cost arm
     writes costMod on a graveyard card (R766).
- Spells with end_of_turn in the catalog (all graveyard returns/adds): core-023/024/031, traininggrounds-049,
  meditative-008, meditative-021, classicplus-021 (radiant), stinkyscape-154.
- Scratch trace build: /tmp/trace (git archive copy; TRACE_SEED/TRACE_CARD prints in duos_fuzz.rs and fuzz.rs).

## Fix design
- A: fuse.rs pub fn spell_text_ends_turn(state, def_id, radiant) (recursive over Spell ingredients);
  resolve.rs flag gate adds it; fuse.rs fused_script wraps each non-Spell ingredient's end_of_turn in
  field_end_of_turn (skip when targets.rs ran_off_the_field(ctx): live self off field and not left field since run
  began; make_context sets exits_from at run start). Ruling R3800000. Tests in crates/cards/tests/cross/hand_returns.rs
  using craft_fused [TWO_GRAPES, ROD] and [DREAM core-023, ROD].
- B: combo_index.rs write_grade returns when card.zone.z() != ZoneName::Field. R3800001. Test in
  crates/engine/tests/rules/combo_index.rs (on_field, exile via jackioh_engine::effects::exile, then start/raise).
- C: tune.rs set_number returns when number is NumberRef::Cost and card in Graveyard/Exile. R3800002. Test in
  crates/engine/tests/rules/effects_tune.rs module classic_plus_41_kys_constant_a_number_set_outright_r386.
